# Carrd
Simple, free, fully responsive one-page sites for pretty much anything.

- [Choose a Starting Point](/build)
- [Log In](/login)

[What is Carrd?](#about)

## Build one-page sites for pretty much anything
Whether it's a personal profile, a landing page to capture emails,
 or something a bit more elaborate, Carrd has you covered.
 Simple, responsive, and yup — totally free.

[!["John Smith" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-1.jpg)](https://johnsmith-demo.carrd.co)[!["Cayce Pollard" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-2.jpg)](https://caycepollard-demo.carrd.co)[!["Jane Anderson" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-3.jpg)](https://janeanderson-demo.carrd.co)[!["Random App" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-4.jpg)](https://randomapp-demo.carrd.co)[!["Showcase" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-5.jpg)](https://showcase-demo.carrd.co)[!["John Smith" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-1.jpg)](https://johnsmith-demo.carrd.co)[!["Cayce Pollard" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-2.jpg)](https://caycepollard-demo.carrd.co)[!["Jane Anderson" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-3.jpg)](https://janeanderson-demo.carrd.co)[!["Random App" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-4.jpg)](https://randomapp-demo.carrd.co)[!["Showcase" demo site preview](assets/website/images/landing/site-5.jpg)](https://showcase-demo.carrd.co)

## Simple
Start with one of [dozens of templates](/build) (or a blank page) and make it your own.

## Responsive
Look great at every screen size right out of the box, from phones to tablets to desktops.

## Free
Build up to three sites per account and use all of Carrd's core features – for free!

## Optional: Go Pro!
Upgrade your Carrd experience! Go Pro from just **$19 / year** (yup, per *year*)
 and get access to Pro-exclusive features like:

- ### Custom Domains

  Publish sites to any custom domains you own with full SSL support (via [Let's Encrypt](https://letsencrypt.org)).
- ### More Sites

  Build and publish more than three sites from a single Carrd account.
- ### Forms

  Add contact, signup (using [Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com), [Kit](https://kit.com), [ActiveCampaign](https://www.activecampaign.com), [EmailOctopus](https://emailoctopus.com), and [many more](/docs/forms/setting-up-a-signup-form)), custom, and payment-enabled forms.
- ### Widgets + Embeds

  Embed your own custom code and widgets from third-party services like [Stripe](https://stripe.com), [PayPal](https://paypal.com), [Gumroad](https://gumroad.com), [Typeform](https://www.typeform.com), and more.
- ### Site Analytics

  Enable optional site analytics and tracking to monitor performance using Google Analytics, Plausible, Matomo, and more.
- ### No Branding

  Publish sites without the "Made with Carrd" branding in the footer.

**Try it free for 7 days**. PayPal and all major credit and debit cards accepted.

- [Learn More](/pro)

## Sound good?
Click below to get started. No signup required.

- [Choose a Starting Point](/build)

# Plans
There are currently three Pro plans to choose from: [**Pro Lite**](#pro-lite), [**Pro Standard**](#pro-standard), and [**Pro Plus**](#pro-plus).

---

## Pro Lite
This is the **entry-level** Pro plan. At just **$9** / year, it offers some nice improvements over the free **Basic** experience while still being extremely affordable. For users who don't use [custom domains](/docs/sites/using-a-custom-domain) or the more business-oriented features of Pro (like [forms](/docs/forms) and [widgets](/docs/building/adding-widgets)), this is *probably* a good fit. Here's what it includes:

- ### 3 Sites

  Build and publish up to 3 sites from a single account.
- ### Premium URLs

  Publish sites to unbranded URLs (like .crd.co) and punycode URLs.
- ### No Branding

  Publish sites without the "Made with Carrd" branding.
- ### High Quality Images

  Publish sites with bigger, higher quality images and backgrounds.
- ### Large Images and Videos

  Upload and use images/GIFs up to 16MB and videos up to 64MB.
- ### No Element Limit

  Build sites with an unlimited number of elements.
- ### Premium Templates

  Access premium starting point templates exclusive to Pro plans.
- ### Custom Templates

  Build and use your own custom templates.
- ### Video Uploads

  Upload and use your own videos throughout your site (or as its background).
- ### Slideshows

  Create fully animated slideshows as backgrounds or standalone elements.
- ### Site Icons

  Show custom icons (aka "favicons") in the address bar when visiting your sites.
- ### Share Images

  Show custom images (instead of screenshots) when sharing your sites on social media.
- ### QR Codes

  Generate and download scannable QR codes for your sites.
- ### Site Transfers

  Transfer ownership of sites to other Carrd users.
- ### Sharing

  Share access to your sites with other Carrd users.

- [Select this plan](/dashboard/account/plan/change/pro-lite)

---

## Pro Standard
This is the **mid-tier** Pro plan. At **$19** / year, this is by far the most popular Pro plan in part because it covers a wide range of use cases: from individuals further branding their sites with [custom domains](/docs/sites/using-a-custom-domain) to businesses using forms to collect email addresses and [customer feedback](/docs/forms/setting-up-a-contact-form). Here's what it includes:

- ### 10 Sites

  Build and publish up to 10 sites from a single account.
- ### Custom Domain URLs

  In addition to premium URLs, publish sites to any custom domains you own (with full SSL support via Let's Encrypt).
- ### No Branding

  Publish sites without the "Made with Carrd" branding.
- ### High Quality Images

  Publish sites with bigger, higher quality images and backgrounds.
- ### Large Images and Videos

  Upload and use images/GIFs up to 16MB and videos up to 64MB.
- ### No Element Limit

  Build sites with an unlimited number of elements.
- ### Premium Templates

  Access premium starting point templates exclusive to Pro plans.
- ### Custom Templates

  Build and use your own custom templates.
- ### Video Uploads

  Upload and use your own videos throughout your site (or as its background).
- ### Slideshows

  Create fully animated slideshows as backgrounds or standalone elements.
- ### Site Icons

  Show custom icons (aka "favicons") in the address bar when visiting your sites.
- ### Share Images

  Show custom images (instead of screenshots) when sharing your sites on social media.
- ### QR Codes

  Generate and download scannable QR codes for your sites.
- ### Site Transfers

  Transfer ownership of sites to other Carrd users.
- ### Sharing

  Share access to your sites with other Carrd users.
- ### Forms

  Add fully functional contact forms and signup forms (using Mailchimp, Kit, ActiveCampaign, EmailOctopus, and many more) to your sites.
- ### Widgets

  Embed third-party widgets from Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Typeform, and Facebook.
- ### Embeds

  Directly embed your own code (including script tags) as well as external content.
- ### Analytics

  Enable optional site analytics to monitor performance using our native, cookie-free analytics service, or a supported third-party provider like Google Analytics, Plausible, and Matomo.
- ### Meta Tags

  Add custom meta tags to each of your sites.
- ### Local Fonts

  Serve font assets directly from your site.

- [Select this plan](/dashboard/account/plan/change/pro-standard)

---

## Pro Plus
This is the **top-tier** Pro plan. At **$49** / year, this plan is built for power users as it offers not only the features of **Pro Standard**, but also more powerful, developer-friendly features like [custom forms](/docs/forms/setting-up-a-custom-form), the [advanced settings](/docs/building/using-advanced-settings) tab, and even the ability to [download](/docs/sites/downloading) the unminified sources of the sites you build. Here's what it includes:

- ### 25 Sites

  Build and publish up to 25 sites from a single account.
- ### Custom Domain URLs

  In addition to premium URLs, publish sites to any custom domains you own (with full SSL support via Let's Encrypt).
- ### No Branding

  Publish sites without the "Made with Carrd" branding.
- ### High Quality Images

  Publish sites with bigger, higher quality images and backgrounds.
- ### Large Images and Videos

  Upload and use images/GIFs up to 16MB and videos up to 64MB.
- ### No Element Limit

  Build sites with an unlimited number of elements.
- ### Premium Templates

  Access premium starting point templates exclusive to Pro plans.
- ### Custom Templates

  Build and use your own custom templates.
- ### Video Uploads

  Upload and use your own videos throughout your site (or as its background).
- ### Slideshows

  Create fully animated slideshows as backgrounds or standalone elements.
- ### Site Icons

  Show custom icons (aka "favicons") in the address bar when visiting your sites.
- ### Share Images

  Show custom images (instead of screenshots) when sharing your sites on social media.
- ### QR Codes

  Generate and download scannable QR codes for your sites.
- ### Site Transfers

  Transfer ownership of sites to other Carrd users.
- ### Sharing

  Share access to your sites with other Carrd users.
- ### Advanced Forms

  In addition to contact and signup forms, build entirely custom forms that integrate with Zapier, Make, n8n and Airtable, send data to URLs, seamlessly incorporate payments (via Stripe Checkout) and more.
- ### Widgets

  Embed third-party widgets from Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Typeform, and Facebook.
- ### Embeds

  Directly embed your own code (including script tags) as well as external content.
- ### Analytics

  Enable optional site analytics to monitor performance using our native, cookie-free analytics service, or a supported third-party provider like Google Analytics, Plausible, and Matomo.
- ### Meta Tags

  Add custom meta tags to each of your sites.
- ### Local Fonts

  Serve font assets directly from your site.
- ### Advanced Settings

  Modify advanced element settings like attributes, custom styles, and JS events.
- ### Download Sites

  Download the unminified HTML, CSS, JS, and images for any sites you build (note: excludes server-side code).
- ### Redirects

  Moving sites to Carrd? Preserve your existing links by redirecting them to sections or external URLs.
- ### Password Protection

  Restrict access to a site using a password.
- ### Variables

  Insert dynamic content into supported elements.
- ### Site Files

  Customize various supporting site files (such as robots.txt and ads.txt).
- ### Framing

  Selectively allow your site to be embedded elsewhere using an IFRAME (inline frame).
- ### Update Frequency

  Explicitly set the update frequency of a site to help improve its performance.
- ### Canonical URL

  Explicitly set the canonical URL of your site.

# Go Pro!
Upgrade your Carrd experience! Go Pro from just **$19 / year** (yup, per *year*)
 and get access to Pro-exclusive features like:

![](/assets/images/marketing/pro/domains.png)

## Custom Domains
Publish sites to any custom domains you own with full SSL support (via [Let's Encrypt](https://letsencrypt.org)).

![](/assets/images/marketing/pro/forms.png)

## Forms
Add contact, signup (using [ActiveCampaign](https://www.activecampaign.com), [beehiiv](https://www.beehiiv.com), [Brevo](https://www.brevo.com), [Buttondown](https://buttondown.email), [EmailOctopus](https://emailoctopus.com), [GetResponse](https://www.getresponse.com), [Ghost](https://ghost.org), [HubSpot](https://hubspot.com), [Kit](https://kit.com), [Klaviyo](https://klaviyo.com), [Loops](https://loops.so), [Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com), [MailerLite](https://www.mailerlite.com), [Mailjet](https://www.mailjet.com), [Omnisend](https://www.omnisend.com), [Resend](https://resend.com), [Sender](https://www.sender.net), [SendFox](https://sendfox.com), [SendGrid](https://sendgrid.com), and [Sendy](https://sendy.co)), custom, and payment-enabled forms.

![](/assets/images/marketing/pro/widgets.png)

Embed your own custom code and widgets from third-party services like [Stripe](https://stripe.com), [PayPal](https://paypal.com), [Gumroad](https://gumroad.com), [Typeform](https://www.typeform.com), and more.

Build and publish more than three sites from a single Carrd account – from 10 sites on a **Standard** plan to 25 sites on a **Plus** plan (and beyond).

## No Branding
Publish sites without the "Made with Carrd" branding.

## Premium Templates
Access premium starting point templates exclusive to Pro plans.

## High Quality Images
Publish sites with bigger, higher quality images and backgrounds.

## Large Images and Videos

## Site Icons

## Bigger Sites
Build sites with an unlimited number of elements.

## Analytics
Enable optional site analytics and tracking to monitor performance using Google Analytics, Plausible, Matomo, and more.

Choose your plan, then instantly upgrade using [PayPal](https://paypal.com) or any major credit or debit card.

# Contact
Have a question or need help with something? Check out the **[documentation](/docs)**, or simply use the form below to get in touch. If you have a copyright issue you'd like to report, please use [this form](/contact/copyright) instead.

Note: We *usually* reply within 24 hours (sometimes a lot sooner), but if you don't hear from us please check your spam/junk folder *or* reach out again from an alternate email.
